name: AI
description: Tools that use a language model through an ai-server: a map laid out from a prompt, an area redone, triggers written and explained, names, briefings, a review of the map, string rewrites, and an assistant that reads and edits everything in the map with you — terrain, units, doodads, sprites, locations, fog, triggers, strings, the script, and every settings dialog.
author: Jeany
